Koh Samui

Samui is the Gulf hub. Use it November is optional; January to September is the easier window. Chaweng is loud. The north and south coasts are quieter.

GulfUSMLomprayah
SeasonEasier January to September
AirportUSM, short drives to most beaches
BoatsLomprayah to Phangan and Tao

Fly BKK-USM when the day matters. The Donsak ferry plus a van from the mainland is the slower, cheaper path.

Nikki Beach and the beach-club row sit on the Samui nightlife page. Six Senses and Four Seasons sit under resort living.

Common questions

Samui or Phuket?
Same job, opposite monsoon. Phuket and Krabi for November to April. Samui and Phangan for January to September, with overlap in winter.
